prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1257; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating into the upper shoulders. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms fit that pattern. Over the course of 29 visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the cervical injury. The patient reported a remote, minor strain in the same region some years earlier, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service, with no duplicated entries. Current status is improved, with residual mild stiffness and a plan for discharge to self-directed exercise.
